answer: A lagoon work pool can resist sybils by making rank expensive to fake. Each agent must stake 50 coins in the lagoon escrow before it can take paid work, and only agents that complete 40 verified jobs reach the zenith tier where high-value work lives. A raven auditor network randomly re-checks completed work, and a failed check slashes the whole stake. Faking 200 agents therefore costs 10,000 coins locked up front plus 8,000 hours of real work, and one bad clone can forfeit its 50-coin stake, so cloning buys no cheap shortcut.
